summary: Runs Python callbacks when selected panel values on monitored Panel COMPs change state, including on/off edges, while-on/off, and value-change events.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable response to monitored panel components

key_params.name: executeloc
key_params.note: Choose script execution context for callbacks

key_params.name: fromop
key_params.note: Operator path used when Execute From is Specified Operator

key_params.name: panels
key_params.note: Panel components whose panel values should be monitored

key_params.name: panelvalue
key_params.note: Panel value names that trigger callbacks

key_params.name: offtoon
key_params.note: Run onOffToOn() when the panel value switches from off to on

key_params.name: whileon
key_params.note: Run whileOn() while the panel value is on

key_params.name: ontooff
key_params.note: Run onOnToOff() when the panel value switches from on to off

key_params.name: whileoff
key_params.note: Run whileOff() while the panel value is off

key_params.name: valuechange
key_params.note: Run onValueChange() when the panel value changes

key_params.name: file

key_params.name: syncfile
key_params.note: Synchronize DAT contents with the external file

key_params.name: loadonstart

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: While On and While Off callbacks execute every frame while the condition is true, so generated scripts need cheap idempotent bodies.
Each panel event fires only one trigger even if several related toggles are enabled for the same value change.
Callback methods receive a panelValue object; use panelValue.name and panelValue.val rather than assuming a fixed row shape.
Sync to File can write DAT edits to disk immediately and should be enabled only for intentional external-script workflows.
key_concepts: Runs scripts when monitored panel values change on selected Panel COMPs.
Trigger toggles map to panel callback methods such as off-to-on, while-on, on-to-off, while-off, and value-change.
Callbacks receive the changed panelValue object so scripts can inspect its name and value.
File and execute-location controls define where callback script text lives and runs.
